unknown.title: The panel does not know this rule
unknown.description: It can be edited only as JSON. It is kept unchanged.

conditions.unknown: Conditions are not shown: the panel does not know this rule’s fields. Edit them on the JSON tab.
conditions.empty: No conditions: the rule takes all traffic, and the rules below never fire.
conditions.group: Conditions are joined with “{{mode}}” in nested rules. Edit them on the JSON tab.
conditions.inverted: The condition is inverted: the rule fires when it does not hold.
